name: smwsprites-mario-bros-arcade-pow-block
title: Mario Bros. Arcade POW Block
description:
A POW meant to be used in conjunction with the other Mario Bros. Arcade sprites made by Sonikku. When smashed, it'll shake the screen and affect said sprites. If the extra bit is set, it'll be displaced 8 pixels to the right, useful if you want it centered in a specific screen.

This sprite was part of Sonikku's Mario Bros. (Arcade) sprite pack, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards.
